verdicts.falsifiability_why: The D9-dropped fixture (sum 0.91, D2 at 40 -> 9.89 vs 9.0) and the mocked L4 band are concrete red-before cases; the parity test over five fixtures would catch any future re-multiplication.
verdicts.notes: Impact 7 claimed; 6 is honest - the disagreement is only visible on dropped-dimension scans. Lines drift only. DimLine.tsx at 256 has room; ReportView untouched. Write set 10 + 1 new, within floors. No overlap with run-1 trends (TrendChart.tsx/DimensionTrends.tsx landed, not in this set) or run-2.

verdicts.title: The waterfall explains the move: a since-last-scan bridge, points by dimension
verdicts.ambition_why: Attributing the delta in the unit of the headline, on the tab that shows the headline, with the residual made explicit - the move a principal would make on a glass-box score.
verdicts.grounding_why: ScoringTab.tsx:50 DeltaPill, ScoreWaterfall.tsx:34 contributions(report) only, reportSeries.ts:41-61 baselineScan/prevDimScores, HistoryPoint carries engineProvider/rubricVersion/dimensions, compare.ts/WhatChanged* have zero 'weight' hits, mixesEngines/MIXED_ENGINE_PAIR_NOTE/sameRuler all exist (chartEngine line numbers stale: :37/:54 not :164/:181).

verdicts.notes: ReportView.tsx is at 291/300 - the card already flags it as tight; the builder must not add more than the one prop. Builds on contributions() shares, so if charts A lands first the bridge should import dimensionShares() rather than re-deriving - sequence A before B or have B call contributions() (which A keeps). a9abacb3 (waterfall lift direction) already landed and is not this idea.

verdicts.grounding_why: integrations.ts:52-55 increment on mode add inside an untransacted loop, metrics/route.ts:71-77 parallel fold with no receipt, agent-sessions.ts:31 increment, otlp-wire.ts:16-21 no startTimeUnixNano (grep confirms it is never read), schema @@unique is the day bucket, ingest-guard 503 retry-after, no dedup/idempot/replay hits on the push path.

verdicts.notes: Metering check: AiUsageRecord.costCents is measured vendor spend for Delivery ROI, not anything Ascent charges; the hosted ceiling is a reservation (hosted-ceiling.ts:15-17), not this table. Nothing paid-for changes. Migration dir 20261023120000_otlp_point_receipt shares its timestamp prefix with oauth B's 20261023120000_login_discovery - distinct names so Prisma orders them, but both edit prisma/schema.prisma (overlap listed). Response gains fields only - ingest contract stays additive. Write set 7 + 5 new, L; within floors.

verdicts.title: One call-pricing rule: every /usage fold prices a call by one basis + reason
verdicts.ambition_why: Three drifting pricers folded into one authority with a reason enum, which also fixes a stated-but-false 'reconcile by construction' doc claim - the registry's price-table law applied properly.
verdicts.grounding_why: usage.ts:508-526 prices every non-BYOM group at env rates with no zero-cost check, :714-717 table path prices zero-cost at $0 and marks priced, meter.ts:197 returns null for zero-cost, :579-580 lane row mixes env estimate with table-only unpricedScanCalls, :797/:907 repo/team cells use the table only, :172-175 'reconcile by construction' comment, teamTotals has no unpriced count while repoTotals uses _count{_all,costMicros}.
verdicts.falsifiability_why: Each case names the two sites that disagree today and the exact value after; the equality chain byTeam === byRepo === byLane under env rates is a strong discriminator; the BYOM guard pins the non-regression.
verdicts.notes: Metering check passed: this changes displayed estimates only. UsageEvent.costMicros is not read by scan-credit, entitlement, plans, polar or billing routes; the hosted agent ceiling is a reservation (hosted-ceiling.ts:15-17), not a ledger sum. isBillableScan and scan counts untouched. The meter change (zero-cost -> 0 micros instead of null) will make new ledger rows for local providers read as priced $0 - the card states it; older rows keep null and will still count unpriced, so a mixed-period floor is expected after deploy (worth one sentence in usage.md). Impact 8 claimed; 7 honest.

verdicts.grounding_why: followup-claims.ts:374 and :398 guard on holder name + in_progress only, :238 claim data never resets needsHuman, no `needsHuman: false` write anywhere in src/, :322-336 holder clause documented as transitional, mcp/route.ts:278 still sets legacyActor, work-tools.ts:356-366 passes it with no generation, ascent-work.mjs:124-131/172-193 claim-run-report with no fence, ea78013b dated 2026-09-05.

The GitHub Action / gate API are untouched. Shared doc README with followups B. Semantic coupling with B: both write needsHuman:false (A at claim, B at take-over/send-back) - compatible, no file overlap.
